method: Current Codex assistant authored descriptions and hard category labels directly in this session. No external teacher API, logits, probabilities, student training or rationale-distillation loss was used.
teacher: Codex assistant in this conversation; exact deployed model revision unavailable
provenance_group: Each pair shares source_group; downstream near-duplicate grouping may merge more groups.
style: Accented and unaccented Vietnamese, colloquial descriptions, abbreviations, explicit cross-category contexts and approved bare defaults.
generation_constraints: One identified expense per description; six taxonomy v2 labels only.
Explicit goods or services take priority over merchant, platform, payment method and amount.
Bare grab defaults to transport; bare shopee/mua do to shopping; bare bao ban be to other.
Unknowns are not automatically other; income, transfers between own wallets and loan principal are outside scope.
No personal identifiers or real transaction records; no external corpus copied.
generation_reproducibility: The source CSVs preserve the actual generated output. AI wording is not reproducible from a random seed; seed 42 is used only for downstream grouped splitting.
limitations: AI-supplied labels have not been independently human-reviewed.
Two phrasings per scenario are intentionally related and must remain in the same split.
Balanced synthetic class frequencies and writing style are not representative of production traffic.
Synthetic validation/test sets only support development checks; use an independent human-labeled real-world test set for quality claims.
Near-duplicate grouping is heuristic, not a guarantee against all semantic overlap.
